parameters.query:
select w.id as will_id, w.lead_id, w.active_notification_state as trigger_state, l.full_name, l.email, l.phone
from wills w join leads l on l.id = w.lead_id
where w.active_notification_state is not null and w.notification_count = 0
limit 50;
